question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}0.\overset{―}{4} & =0.444… \\  & =0.4+0.04+0.004+… \\  & =\frac{4}{10}+\frac{4}{100}+\frac{4}{1\,000}+….\end{aligned}
$$

We see that we have a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{4}{10}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{10}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}0.\overset{―}{4} & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{4}{10}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }4(\frac{1}{10}){(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & ={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }4{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
